name: BONC Horinger Intelligent Computing Center (东方国信和林格尔智算中心)
developer: BONC Software Co., Ltd. (东方国信, 300166.SZ)
notes: New project (not in prior CN registry). Total investment 3.0B CNY; 8 data-center buildings; 10,000 racks (1万个数据机柜) => 60 MW at 6kW/rack. DeepSeek full models deployed on its self-developed 幕僚智数 large-model training/inference platform by 2025-02. Located in Horinger New District (东数西算 Horinger cluster). Source: Inner Mongolia Enterprise Federation reprint of 青橙融媒 (Hohhot official media).

name: Paratera Inner Mongolia Computing Base (并行科技内蒙古算力基地)
developer: Beijing Paratera Technology Co., Ltd. (北京并行科技股份有限公司)
notes: New project (not in prior CN registry). Total investment ~3.0B CNY => ~60 MW at 2MW/亿 conversion. Building a 60,000 PFLOPS smart-compute service platform with 10,000-GPU cluster (H800/A800/昇腾910) in Horinger New District; DeepSeek models deployed 2025-02. Capacity is investment-based; the reported 6万P target was not converted to MW to avoid overstatement.

name: Horinger Intelligent Computing Center (和林格尔智算中心, 云著智算)
developer: Beijing Huazhu Technology / Yunzhu Zhisuan (北京华著科技/云著智算; to be injected into *ST东易 002713.SZ)
notes: New project (not in prior CN registry). ~200 mu site; reported total scale 280 MW (directly reported). Located in Horinger New District (东数西算 national DC cluster). Per *ST东易 (002713.SZ) restructuring filings of 2025-11-14, facility not yet completed/commissioned (尚未建成投产), with disclosed rack-utilization risk; Huazhu Technology committed to inject operator Yunzhu Zhisuan's equity into the listed vehicle within one year of court approval.

name: Zhongjin Data Ulanqab Zero-Carbon Computing Industrial Park/Base (中金数据乌兰察布零碳算力产业园/基地)
developer: Zhongjin Data Systems Co., Ltd. (中金数据系统有限公司)
notes: New project (not in prior CN registry). Located in Chahar High-Tech Development Zone (察哈尔高新技术开发区), Ulanqab; tens of thousands of servers running (operational, 数万台服务器). Deputy Prime Minister Ding Xuexiang visited May 2026 (Xinhua) on 算电协同/low-carbon computing. May share the campus with previously registered 'Zhongjin Jingmeng Green Computing Industrial Park Phase II' — overlap to be verified. Capacity MW not published.

name: China Unicom-Zhonghong Zijing Wulanchabu Intelligent Computing Center (中国联通-中弘紫晶乌兰察布智算中心)
developer: China Unicom (中国联通) + Inner Mongolia Zhonghong Zijing Co., Ltd. (内蒙古中弘紫晶有限公司)
notes: Re-verified (already in CN registry as construction). Groundbreaking 2024-09-10 at Jining logistics park (集宁物流园区); planned investment 3.3B CNY; 22,000 new racks => 132 MW at 6kW/rack; 97,000 m2 new DC space; 3-year build to ~2027; companion 1.3B CNY 源网荷储 green-power project (250 MW renewables, ~680 GWh/yr). Source: 数据中心世界网 reprint via chaosuanwiki.

name: China Mobile Hohhot Data Center / Intelligent Computing Center (中国移动呼和浩特数据中心/智算中心)
developer: China Mobile Inner Mongolia (中国移动内蒙古公司)
notes: Re-verified (already in CN registry as operational; registry also lists B17-B18 computer-room buildings as planned). Inner Mongolia Ecology & Environment Dept (自治区生态环境厅) published EIA (radiation) approval result 2026-07-20 for the new 220kV Substation No.3 serving the Hohhot Data Center, supporting the B17-B18 expansion. Single-campus intelligent compute 6,700 P (2025-02, world's largest single intelligent-compute center); visited by Deputy PM Ding Xuexiang May 2026 (Xinhua).

name: UCloud Wulanchabu Intelligent Computing Center (优刻得乌兰察布智算中心)
developer: UCloud Technology Co., Ltd. (优刻得科技股份有限公司)
notes: Re-verified (CN registry has UCloud Wulanchabu Cloud Computing Center, operational, 200 MW). 2026-06 同花顺/证券时报 report describes the Ulanqab center as an operating 'Token factory' with liquid-cooled racks in service, confirming continued operation. Capacity carried over from prior registry entry.

Coverage: province-wide regulatory-pipeline searches (节能审查意见公示/环评受理批复公示/地市发改委备案公告 via DuckDuckGo) surfaced no Wuhai data-center or intelligent-computing project evidence in this pass; consistent with existing registry coverage line for Wuhai. All 12 Inner Mongolia divisions already have registry coverage (35 project records + Wuhai no_projects); this file adds only new-evidence items and re-verifications.
